scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node init && cross-env PORT=5003 npm --prefix orbitfood-backend run server
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm --prefix orbitfood-frontend run dev
scripts.build: node init && npm install --prefix orbitfood-backend --include=dev && npm install --prefix orbitfood-frontend --include=dev && npm --prefix orbitfood-frontend run build
